name: Gear Combination
detailed_description:
A Must-Play Puzzle Game for Gear Lovers – Now Enhanced for Steam!

The popular mobile puzzle game Gear Combination is now available on Steam, completely powered up with enhanced graphics, smoother controls, and a more immersive experience tailored for PC players.

The game begins with a single rotating gear. Your objective is to combine various gears of different sizes and tooth counts to reach the target rotation speed. You can freely place gears anywhere on the field—watching them interlock and spin in perfect synchronization is a deeply satisfying experience, especially for gear enthusiasts.

Rotational speeds are expressed using positive values for clockwise rotation and negative values for counterclockwise. While the rules are simple, achieving the right gear ratios and placements requires thoughtful strategy and planning.

With multiple quests available, you're free to tackle them in any order. Previously cleared stages can be replayed as many times as you like, allowing you to refine your solutions or just enjoy the mechanics at your own pace.

Whether you're a fan of mechanical puzzles or simply looking for a relaxing and engaging way to spend your time, Gear Combination offers a unique gameplay experience that combines creativity, logic, and the mesmerizing motion of gears.

Ready to find your perfect gear combination?
